biotools.summary: MGI (Mouse Genome Informatics) is a knowledgebase providing integrated genetic, genomic, and biological data for the laboratory mouse to facilitate research on human health and disease. It serves as a central resource, integrating data from multiple databases and providing access to FAIR-compliant data.
